title: Dotted-eighth echo
instruction: Build an echo effect (write the kernel) and put it on the Snaps track: repeats at a dotted eighth, locked to the song's tempo, each repeat at least 6 dB under the dry hit, and the dry hit left as it is.

checks.label: An effect written in this song is on Snaps
First repeat's distance from a dotted eighth (worst of 100 and 130 bpm)
First repeat against the dry hit
